But to give an example, I personally know someone who freely accuses people of being ableist as a way to make herself immune to any kind of criticism (constructive or otherwise). She'll treat someone poorly or take advantage of them, and then claim that it's because of her anxiety/depression and behave as if it makes her unaccountable. As with most of the buzzwords that have blossomed in the last few years, the word itself refers to something real (it's why the US had to pass the Americans with Disabilities Act, to legally protect the disabled from discrimination) but it gets misused as a way to facilitate being a shitty person while still maintaining a faux moral superiority.
